title: 第4章 继续忽悠
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

消息是一个朋友发来的。

“小筝！王大丫要结婚了！听说她老公还蛮有钱的，酒席定在我们市最大的酒楼！”

“我记得她还欠你钱呢！你不趁机去要一下？”

谭筝点开朋友发来的电子请柬。

请柬里王大丫锥子脸、高鼻梁、精灵耳，跟当初长的两模两样，毫不相关，正一脸甜蜜的倚靠在她老公的肩膀上。

她老公……嗯……丑得谭筝一时间找不到形容词。

去！怎么不去？！

当初王大丫连坑带骗的找她借过几次钱，加起来也有万把块了，可后来这王大丫就像是人间蒸发一样，连影子都寻不到。

好不容易逮到机会，谭筝势必要让她连本带利地吐出来！

谭筝在最后一页找到了时间和地点，明天中午十二点，在御景世纪酒店的鎏光宴会厅。

她截了个图，果断加入明日的行动计划。

奔波了一天，谭筝拖着疲惫的身躯回到了出租屋，还没来得及喘口气，催命的电话再次响起。

“又是谁啊！”

她有些崩溃地大喊了一声，拿起手机一看。

是她妈，潘丽。

“喂，妈，你打电话给我有什么事吗？”

“小筝啊，你都两个月没交家用了，你弟刚动完手术，还需要补营养呢。”

果然无事不登三宝殿，来催家用了。

一想起自己那个被卸载了蛋蛋的弟弟，谭筝就想笑，再怎么补营养，消失的蛋又不会长出来。

但她忍住了，很是委屈地说：

“妈，不是我不想交家用啊，公司拖欠了好几个月的工资，我现在连吃饭都成问题，还想先找你借点呢。”

听到没钱，潘丽立马不高兴了。

“你那什么公司啊，这么不靠谱，当初我都跟你说了，就在家门口的超市做收银，一个月三千块，发的可准时了，家里有什么事情你也能马上照应。”

“江洲呢？他什么时候带你去见他爸妈啊？有没有跟你说过彩礼出多少？”

The message was from a friend.

"Xiao Zheng! Wang Daya is getting married! I heard that her husband is quite rich, and the banquet will be held at the largest restaurant in our city!"

"I remember she still owes you money! Why don't you take the opportunity to ask for it?"

Tan Zheng clicked on the electronic invitation sent by her friend.

In the invitation, Wang Daya's awl face, high nose bridge, and elf ears are completely different from her original appearance. She is leaning on her husband's shoulder with a sweet look on her face.

Her husband...well...so ugly that Tan Zheng couldn't find any adjectives for a while.

go!Why not?!

At first, Wang Daya borrowed money from her several times through deception, which amounted to tens of thousands of yuan. But later, Wang Daya seemed to have disappeared from the world, and even her shadow could not be found.

When she finally got the chance, Tan Zheng was bound to make her spit it out with profit!

Tan Zheng found the time and place on the last page. Tomorrow at 12 noon, it will be in the gilded banquet hall of Yujing Century Hotel.

She took a screenshot and decided to join tomorrow's action plan.

After running around for a day, Tan Zheng dragged his exhausted body back to the rental house. Before he could take a breath, the reminder phone rang again.

"Who is it again?"

She yelled a little collapsed and picked up her phone to look at it.

It's her mother, Pan Li.

"Hey, Mom, what's the matter with you calling me?"

"Xiao Zheng, you haven't paid for household expenses for two months. Your brother just had an operation and still needs nutrition."

Sure enough, he went to the Three Treasures Hall to help the family.

Tan Zheng wanted to laugh when he thought of his younger brother who had his balls removed. No matter how much he supplemented his nutrition, the missing eggs would not grow back.

But she held it back and said aggrievedly:

"Mom, it's not that I don't want to pay for the household expenses. The company has been in arrears with wages for several months. Now I can't even eat, so I want to borrow some from you first."

Pan Li immediately became unhappy when she heard that there was no money.

"What kind of company is that of yours? It's so unreliable. I told you back then. I work as a cashier in the supermarket in front of your home. It costs three thousand yuan a month. The payment is on time. You can take care of anything at home right away."

"Where is Jiang Zhou? When will he take you to meet his parents? Has he told you how much the bride price will be?"
